jobs.title: Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Java Backend Developer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7485

Join our TPA Dev team in Madrid and grow into a Calypso Developer. You’ll start as a seasoned Java backend engineer and receive structured training on Calypso, used for Triparty Collateral Management and Repo Services at SIX. This is an on-the-job learning path: you’ll build production-grade services while deepening your knowledge of Calypso and the post-trade domain.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and operate backend services in Java for collateral management and repo workflows, evolving into Calypso customizations and integrations.

• Develop robust, multi-threaded services and APIs using Java 8+ and Spring Boot; expose and consume RESTful interfaces.

• Implement event-driven integrations (e.g., messaging/streaming) between Calypso and internal/external systems.

• Model, optimize, and maintain relational data structures; write efficient SQL and work with ORM frameworks (Hibernate/JPA).

• Contribute to solution design and architecture, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and observability across services.

• Collaborate closely with business analysts, Calypso specialists, and SRE/DevOps to deliver reliable, compliant, and secure solutions.

• Participate in the full SDLC: requirements, estimation, implementation, code reviews, testing (unit/integration), deployment, and production support.

• Embrace infrastructure and platform standards (e.g., Linux RHEL 8+, containerization, CI/CD) and help automate build/test/deploy pipelines.

• Learn and extend Calypso: configuration, workflows, data models, APIs, and custom components to support triparty collateral and repo processes.

• Contribute to continuous improvement: reduce technical debt, improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance developer productivit

What You Bring

• 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a strong focus on multithreaded backend development in Java (Java 8+).

• Proficiency with Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and building reliable distributed services.

• Strong database skills: SQL expertise, sound schema design, and experience with Hibernate/JPA.

• Solid understanding of object-oriented design, event-driven architectures, and messaging patterns.

• Familiarity with Linux environments (RHEL 8+), and comfort working with modern CI/CD practices and tooling.

• Understanding of financial markets and post-trade infrastructure; exposure to collateral or repo is a plus.

• Growth mindset: positive, result-driven, quality-focused, and systematic thinker with a problem-solving attitude.

• Collaborative communicator, team-oriented, resilient under pressure; ability to work in a cross-functional, multicultural environment.

• Language skills: English required; German and/or Spanish are a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (80 -100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Account Manager (80 -100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7956

We are looking for an experienced Senior Sales & Relationship Manager to join our Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein team in Zurich. In this role, you will act as a senior and trusted partner for clients, owning relationships end to end and driving sustainable revenue growth through upselling and cross selling within existing accounts.

This position is designed for a seasoned professional who operates with a high degree of autonomy, carries a significant sales target, and is ready to actively shape client relationships and commercial

What You Will Do

• act as a senior, trusted point of contact for clients, managing complex inquiries, commercial discussions, and stakeholder interactions with confidence.

• build, develop, and deepen long term relationships at all levels within client organizations, including senior and executive stakeholders.

• proactively identify and execute upselling and cross selling opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth against ambitious targets.

• own the onboarding of new clients and ensure a seamless transition into our services, laying the foundation for long term partnerships.

• develop a deep understanding of client needs, market trends, and regulatory dynamics to anticipate challenges and deliver tailored, value adding solutions.

• collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure high quality delivery, client satisfaction, and a consistently positive client experience.

• represent the company as a senior ambassador at client meetings, executive touchpoints, industry events, and conferences.

• manage and continuously develop a robust sales pipeline, providing accurate forecasting, transparent reporting, and clear visibility on commercial performance.

What You Bring

• over 10 years of experience in sales and/or client relationship management, ideally within financial services or a complex B2B environment.

• proven ability to independently manage, grow, and retain client portfolios, including carrying and delivering against significant revenue targets.

• strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage at senior and executive levels.

• high level of ownership, accountability, and commercial acumen, combined with a proactive and results driven mindset.

• excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

• fluency in English and German required; additional languages are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Sales Support Specialist with German

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7754

Do you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy working at the intersection of sales, clients, and operations? Are you passionate about creating seamless processes and delivering high-quality client experiences?

Then our Banking Services Business Management Team wants to hear from you!

SIX Banking Services is the payment solution provider to the majority of banks in Switzerland. In this role you will enable efficient banking-related sales processes, strengthen client relationships, and ensure operational excellence. You will work closely with sales & account managers, product experts, and internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• coordinate client engagements, including meetings, demos, workshops, and the preparation of tailored presentations and sales materials to banking services clients

• align agendas and communication across internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure smooth execution and consistent messaging

• maintain and update CRM data (SAP Sales Cloud), ensuring accurate tracking of client information, sales opportunities, and pipeline status

• manage proactive follow-ups on sales activities, support proposal and contract preparation, and ensure proper documentation and archiving

• compile and structure sales figures, KPIs, and client insights to support reporting, analysis, and continuous improvement

What You Bring

• experience in sales support or business operations, ideally within banking or financial services

• strong ability to create professional client presentations and structure sales-related data and KPIs

• proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM systems (SAP Sales Cloud required)

• excellent organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate agendas, documentation, and multiple stakeholders

• fluent in English and German (written and spoken); additional training or certification in Sales Operations, CRM, or Data Analysis is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Quality Assurance Engineer

Madrid |  Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7648

Do you want to be part of a dynamic environment where software quality is a top priority? Are you passionate about ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance products? If so, our quality team wants to hear from you!

We are an agile team focused on ensuring that our solutions meet the highest quality standards. We are responsible for validating key functionalities, automating tests, and continuously improving our testing processes. Our goal is to deliver an impeccable user experience and guarantee product stability in every release.

In this role, you will work closely with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers, participating in the entire development lifecycle to ensure quality from day one.

What You Will Do

• Design, execute, and automate backend and end‑to‑end tests using Java and JavaScript, ensuring the quality and stability of developed services.

• Validate data‑processing microservices architectures, including Spark‑ and Cloudera‑based components, as well as Kafka integrations and data consolidation/transformation checks.

• Perform and analyze performance tests using JMeter, identifying improvement areas, detecting potential bottlenecks, and producing detailed technical reports.

• Manage and document the full testing lifecycle using Xray: test case design, sprint execution, incident tracking, and functional/technical certification of releases.

• Collaborate continuously with development, business, and monitoring teams, providing technical documentation in English and defining validation procedures for deployments to production environments

What You Bring

• Strong technical skills in Java and JavaScript, with proven experience in test automation using the Karate framework to ensure backend service quality and consistency.

jobs.title: Backend Java Developer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Backend Java Developer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7838

You want to code? You want to code for one of the most technologically advanced and innovative and stable stock exchanges? Are you ready to work at SIX? We need your engineering skills and passion for designing and implementing new features with great user experience. In your position you will be a part of the Trading Application Development team contributing and driving back-end development of our products. Your main duties as a Software Engineer, working as a Java Developer, will be the following

What You Will Do

• exert your excellent Java developing skills with focus on back-end development in the area of primary market trading and trading GUI for the secondary market

• responsible to keep the application compliant to internal and external regulations

• translate user expectations and business requirements into state of the art solution designs following best practice in Java development

• work closely in an interdisciplinary team of developers, testers, product owners and business stakeholders in an agile environment (SCRUM and SAFe)

What You Bring

•  5 years of professional hands-on experience in software engineering, with focus on multi-threaded applications development in Java (Java 8+, SpringBoot, WildFly, SOAP and REST services).

• A backpack of experience that includes excellent database knowledge with SQL and Hibernate.

• Excellent knowledge of object-oriented design, event-based message systems, and database design and development and may be also about FIX protocol or financial markets and their infrastructure.

• A positive and result-driven attitude with a high sense for quality, systematic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.

• Communicative, team-oriented and resilient personality – German and Spanish is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Head Controlling Exchanges (80-100%)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Controlling Exchanges (80-100%)

Madrid, Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8051

Do you want to help shape the financial steering of one of Europe’s leading exchange businesses? As Head Controlling Exchanges at SIX/BME, you will be a trusted finance partner to the Head and Management Team of Business Unit Exchanges. You act as business partner and create transparency on financial performance, translate complex data into actionable insights and support sound decision-making across our exchanges in Switzerland and Spain. By combining analytical and financial skills with curiosity and ownership with impact, you will contribute to the continued transformation of financial markets.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Act as trusted finance business and sparring partner to the Head of Exchanges and his leadership team, supporting and challenging strategic and operational decisions

• Lead key controlling processes, including closing, forecasting, budgeting and mid-term planning, ensuring high-quality insights, transparency and timely delivery

• Prepare, comment and present monthly financial cockpits, variance analyses and ad-hoc deep dives for senior and executive management

• Drive performance steering by identifying risks and opportunities, challenging assumptions and translating financial transparency into actionable insights and clear recommendations

• Continuously improve controlling processes, reporting tools and data foundations, contributing to the continuing success of the Exchanges business

What You Bring

• Bachelor and/or Master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting, controlling or a comparable qualification

• At least 4–6 years of experience in financial management or controlling, ideally gained in an international company or through international exposure

• Solid expertise in planning, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis and financial commentary, with a strong ability to turn figures into business-relevant insights

• Strong business partnering skills, with the ability to build trust, challenge constructively and influence senior stakeholders in a dynamic environment

• Good understanding of the financial industry; knowledge of exchange business models or market infrastructure is a strong advantage

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, with the ability to engage effectively with top and executive management; German and Spanish are a plus

• Experience with SAP BI reporting tools such as Analysis for Office and SAP Analytics Cloud is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Data Availability
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Site Reliability Engineer - Data Availability

Singapore |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7751

We are looking for a skilled and reliability-driven Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to strengthen our engineering team. In this hybrid role, you will combine hands-on 2nd level support responsibilities with monitoring, automation, and reliability engineering. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, observability, and continuous improvement of our production systems supporting real-time financial data processing.

What You Will Do

Operational Support & Incident Management

• Provide 2nd level support for production systems and critical business applications.

• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and performance issues.

• Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and document findings in a structured manner.

Monitoring, Observability & Automation

•

• Design, implement, and maintain monitoring dashboards.

• Improve alert quality and reduce noise through effective threshold and metric design.

• Analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior to proactively detect anomalies, automate operational processes using Ansible and scripting.

What You Bring

• Operational Mindset & Collaboration

• Proven experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or 2nd level production support.

• Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills

• Hands-on experience with Elastic Stack and Grafana for monitoring and logging.

• Experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.

• Experience with Git/GitLab.

• Familiarity with scripting languages.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What We Offer

Flexible Work Models

We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Personal Development

You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

jobs.title: Financial Securities Specialist with French
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Financial Securities Specialist with French

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7907



At SIX, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to a leading financial market infrastructure provider by ensuring the quality and reliability of reference data across funds, fixed income, and shares. Following a structured onboarding, the position focuses on maintaining accurate data, supporting regulatory compliance, and delivering high standards of service to clients. The role combines analytical responsibilities with functional client support in an international and data‑driven environment. It is well suited for candidates interested in financial markets and the core processes that support them.

What You Will Do:

• entering reference data into SIX different databases

• verifying data consistency and performing second-level checks

• providing functional assistance to clients

What You Bring:

• fluent French speaking

• first experience in the financial data industry or a related field is a plus

• knowledge of French and European fund/Fixed Income/Shares regulations

• understanding of the fund/Fixed Income/Shares ecosystem (market players, data distribution systems, Back/Front office concepts)

• SQL language knowledge is a plus

• experience with JIRA and Confluence tools

• higher education background in management/finance (ideally a Master’s degree)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Product Owner

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7635

We’re looking for a Product Owner to join our Product Platforms team and own the product backlog for systems that ingest, normalize, enrich, and process content. You’ll collaborate across engineering, architecture, content operations, data governance, and product stakeholders to deliver capabilities that enable downstream products.
You will operate within SAFe, working primarily with an Agile team (or teams) within an Agile Release Train (ART), translating platform strategy into clear outcomes, stories, and increments.

What You Will Do

•    Own and prioritize the team backlog aligned to ART objectives.
•    Author epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements (NFRs)
•    Maintain a transparent roadmap and release plans
•    Participate in PI Planning, define team objectives, and sequence features for maximum value delivery.
•    Lead backlog refinement, iteration planning, daily scrums, system demos, and Inspect & Adapt workshops.
•    Collaborate with Product Managers, System Architect, Engineering teams, and RTE to ensure alignment and architectural runway.

What You Bring

•    2-5 years in Product Ownership/Management for data platforms, content systems, or integration-heavy products.
•    Hands-on experience working in SAFe or large-scale agile environments;
•    Background in content ingestion/processing  (e.g., feeds, files, APIs), Stream processing, ETL/ELT, and workflow orchestration would be a plus
•    Familiarity with data quality frameworks, metadata/cataloging, and content normalization
•    Ability to define NFRs (performance, reliability, security) and collaborate on SLOs design
•    Excellent communication skills; proven stakeholder management, professional English is a must, German an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Sales & Account Management for Cards, ATM and TWINT (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7669

Are you excited about developing strategic client relationships and leading a high‑performing sales team? As Head Sales & Account Management for Cards, ATM and TWINT, you will shape our long‑term growth by defining how we collaborate with our key clients and by building scalable structures that position us for the future. You combine strategic perspective with strong operational execution and create tangible value for our clients in every interaction.

What You Will Do

• Lead, develop and coach a team of 4 Account Managers and build a clear, performance‑driven and transparent sales culture

• Develop and execute a structured client‑development approach, including account planning, pipeline steering and reliable forecasting

• Implement scalable sales processes, CRM standards and data‑driven methods to ensure consistent and efficient client management

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Support, Onboarding, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Data Analytics and the Sales Support team in Poland to ensure an integrated client experience

• Manage strategic key accounts end‑to‑end – from opportunity development and stakeholder coordination to long‑term relationship management

What You Bring

• Several years of leadership experience (5+ years) in developing and managing high‑performing B2B sales teams; experience working with near‑shore support teams is an advantage

• Solid B2B sales experience in strategic market development; industry knowledge and an established network in the Swiss debit and credit cards market are a clear benefit

• Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and to build long‑term, trust‑based client relationships.

• Strong commercial mindset, excellent storytelling skills, high affinity for AI, and strong analytical and operational capabilities – with the ability to translate market insights into concrete actions and measurable results

• Excellent German and English skills (understanding of Swiss German required); French is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
